description: Cryptstalker Headpiece Level 60 Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Cryptstalker Headpiece if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Headpiece - Wartorn Chain Scrap x 15 - Arcanite Bar x 4 - Nexus Crystal x 2
name: Cryptstalker Headpiece
